name: material-3-frosted
description: Android 17 frosted-glass design system for Material 3 Expressive — glass chrome, blur, fallbacks and accessibility for Jetpack Compose.

plugins.name: material-3-frosted
plugins.description: Build the Android 17 frosted-glass look: translucent blurred chrome over Material 3 Expressive. Includes glass placement rules, Haze 2 Glass/Blur and platform window blur patterns, opaque fallbacks, reduce-blur accessibility, a 12-dimension audit rubric, and a static UI scanner for existing apps.
